intent.raw: Map and later implement the Body War journey from login through SuggestedTrack confirmation, Strava-derived candidate geometry, and a visible score preview.
intent.objective: Route separately authorized decisions, implementation units, local validation, moderated testing, real-provider integration, and hosted witness evidence without collapsing their authority.
intent.operator_sentence: No step is selected or authorized by this dispatch document.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The implementation units overlap one Body War app and must pass sequential schema, policy, and evidence gates.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Use one bounded Task Session at a time. Parallel agents would create avoidable overlap in repository, server, UI, migration, and test files.

steps.name: Resolve local score and geometry policy decisions
stop_conditions: block numeric implementation until ScorePolicy is ratified
block participant geometry persistence until privacy and retention are ratified

steps.name: Build the local fixture prototype
stop_conditions: one SWU per Task Session
block if fake and real provider modes are ambiguous
block if ownership evidence ordering canonical score input or active sink coverage is ambiguous
block on any source-backed or control-authority inflation

steps.name: Validate and run moderated local formative sessions
stop_conditions: do not recruit until code and browser gates pass
preserve formative-only evidence ceiling

steps.name: Resolve the real-provider OAuth scope decision
stop_conditions: do not let the real-provider scope decision block L0 or L1
block SWU-JSP-008 until accepted scope and consent are explicit

steps.name: Build the real Strava activity geometry and score-input gateway
stop_conditions: block if server-only token access cannot be proven
block if accepted scope or concurrent refresh safety cannot be proven
block if raw provider streams reach any enumerated sink
block real comparable score unless the ratified history contract yields a complete canonical snapshot

steps.name: Prepare and validate the hosted admission package
stop_conditions: do not run a participant or live witness
block unless immutable artifact provider mode exact consent and claim-specific receipt validator pass
return to the parent for an explicit admit or reject event

steps.name: Run one separately authorized hosted supervised real-provider witness
stop_conditions: do not start without an explicit parent admit event bound to the admission receipt
one participant one activity one attempt
stop on identity consent state count or receipt ambiguity
do not infer repeat-safe unmoderated production or promotion

gates.condition: DEC-JSP-001 and DEC-JSP-002 have explicit owner decisions and exact artifacts before L0.
DEC-JSP-003 has an explicit owner decision before SWU-JSP-008; it does not block L0 or L1.
All selected L0 SWUs pass scoped type, unit, repository, API, browser, and no-leak checks.
Affirmative consent and exact non-first track binding pass at 320px and 390px plus short-height 200 percent text long-content and orientation stressors.
Non-fake gateway, accepted-scope validation, race-safe token refresh, allow-listing, qualifying-history snapshot, provider failures, and all-sink raw-stream exclusion pass.
A claim-specific HOST receipt proves immutable artifact, non-fake provider mode, exact external consent, one-attempt protocol, and receipt validator; the parent records admit or reject.
An explicit parent admit event is bound to the HOST receipt before one supervised witness runs under its claim-specific schema.

boundaries.contract: Invoke may recommend candidate policies but cannot ratify score, privacy, retention, or OAuth scope.
Only an explicitly selected SWU may mutate the Body War app and each session must return scoped evidence.
Human and live-provider outcomes remain separate from code and browser-test evidence.
A validated HOST package returns to the parent for explicit admit or reject; admission never implies witness execution.

authority.lifecycle: Body War Craft and feature owners
authority.execution: task-session or experiment-harness after explicit selection
authority.evidence: named code browser participant or real-provider receipt

promotion_guardrails: A confirmation may create candidate evidence only.
Score remains preview_only and cannot decide controller or conquest.
A fake-provider pass cannot satisfy a real-provider gate.
A supervised witness cannot imply repeat-safe, unmoderated, production, or source-backed status.
